note: Per-model token prices ($ per 1M tokens) used to DERIVE cost downstream — the harness/skill-creator carry tokens + durations but no dollars (plan §3, §9). The ledger stamps cost_derived_from: 'tokens*price-map@v1' so a row's cost is reproducible against this exact map version. Server-side model + judge drift is not pinned by this file — re-resolve prices and bump `version` + `resolved_at` whenever model IDs are re-resolved (plan decision 3). Claude prices from the claude-api skill table cached 2026-05-26. Cross-family judge prices are best-effort and MUST be re-verified before a cost-gated run (see _verify).
note_cache: cache_read / cache_write are the prompt-cache token tiers ($ per 1M). Anthropic's standard ratios: cache_read = 0.1 × input (the 10x cache-hit discount), cache_write = 1.25 × input (the 5-minute-TTL write surcharge; 1h writes are 2x and are approximated as 5m here — see BENCHMARK-SCHEMA.md). ingest derives cost = (input·in + output·out + cache_read·cr + cache_write·cw)/1e6 (plan §9), and falls back to 0.1×/1.25× of `input` when a model omits these. Validated 2026-06-07 against a real /plan run: model_usage tokens × these tiers reproduced the SDK costUSD ($2.689) to the cent. Cache reads dominate a geniro run (≈2.1M read vs ≈10K fresh input on a /plan trial), so pricing them flat at the input rate over-counts ~4x — these tiers are why cost is cache-aware, not a flat input×price.
note_v1_additive: The cache_* tiers and the [1m] aliases below were ADDED in Phase C without changing any existing input/output price, so no prior ledger row's cost basis moves and `version` stays 1 (a row that carries no cache tokens derives the exact same cost as before). The [1m] suffix is the 1M-context model id the Agent SDK reports in model_usage (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8[1m]`); the claude-api table lists 1M context at the base tier and the real-run validation above confirmed base pricing on 2.1M cached tokens, so the aliases share the base prices. The next genuine price re-resolution bumps version → 2.
